items.context: @ArdiNSC (38.516 seguidores), en inglés: reflexiona que su tesis de BTC buscando los mínimos del rango previo ($48K-$54K) podría cumplirse, admite que el breakout de $83K lo engañó, cuenta que en 2019 compró 280% sobre el mínimo por negar el piso y concluye que ser bajista macro tarde en el ciclo le hizo más daño que ser alcista. Post de ~30 min con 142 likes, 34 respuestas y 12047 vistas. Ángulo: caídas y recuperación por ciclo (Cycle Clock y Drawdown Atlas).
items.suggested_text:
The 2019 story is the part most people skip. Buying higher than the low isn't the failure; refusing to buy at all because the "real" bottom hasn't printed yet is.

The drawdown history backs that up. 2011 fell 92.7% and took 622 days to reclaim its high; 2013 fell 84.5% and needed 1,177. Even inside 2013 there were two peaks: one recovered in 210 days, the other in 1,177. Same asset, same year, completely different patience required.

Nobody times those exactly. What separates outcomes over a full cycle is usually position size, no leverage and a plan that survives being early. The price level matters less than whether you're still holding when the long trend reasserts itself, and that one rarely announces itself in advance.
